## **🎉 🐶 Happy Vet Tech Week 😸 🎉**


We are officially at the start of Vet Tech Appreciation Week! 🎉


As we head into this week, we want to acknowledge each and every veterinary technician out there and extend a thank you for all that you do. This week serves as a great opportunity to appreciate and celebrate your vet techs ❤️ Be sure to do something special for your team this week!


We wanted to share this video that exhibits just a handful of the things a vet tech experiences on a daily (if not, hourly) basis. We hope you like it!


We’ll be posting content across our social media platforms this week and running discussion contests on Vetcove with a chance to win prizes. 🌟


Keep an eye out for our posts to reshare 📱, and be sure you’re following us on Instagram @vetcove and Facebook to stay in the loop!

You guessed it! Vetcove now offers a **mobile app** for your phone or tablet, so you can place orders and manage inventory on the go. 👍


▶️ Learn all about our mobile app features — such as **Product Scanning** , viewing order history, utilizing shopping lists, check CB deals, and view invoices.
